The key-wizard contract is synchronous: navigation leaves exactly one non-overlay section visible, resizes it, and cleans overlays without relying on bubbled `transitionend`. The production change was sound, but `browser_keyWizard.js:119` leaves transitions enabled and can pass under the old implementation. [Task 1]
